questions.question: After drafting, how does the orchestrator treat a user's answer to the assumptions question that is not bare Enter, y, yes, or ok?
choices: It is treated as a correction, applied through the annotation path, and the documents are republished
It aborts the run with OutcomeInterrupted
It is ignored and the plan proceeds unchanged
It triggers a full plan redraft from scratch
questions.rationale: Any answer other than a confirmation is treated as a correction and applied via the annotation path before republishing the documents.

questions.question: In the chained-execution approval gate, what happens when the user presses bare Enter at the "Plan approved — begin execution? [y/N]" prompt?
choices: Execution starts because Enter accepts the default
Execution is declined and the plan files are left intact with the plan-ready outcome
The prompt re-asks until y or n is typed
The plan files are deleted and the run stalls
questions.rationale: The gate defaults to No: only y/yes starts execution, so bare Enter declines and leaves the plan files intact.

questions.question: When the refine loop exhausts its pass cap with unresolved findings, what does choosing "refine" do?
choices: Grants unlimited additional passes until the plan is clean
Deletes REFINEMENTS.md and returns OutcomePlanReady
Grants exactly one more pass, and a still-dirty pass re-asks with no auto-accept path
Waits for the user to edit PLAN.md and STEPS.md by hand
questions.rationale: The refine choice grants exactly one more pass, and a still-dirty pass returns to the gate to re-ask with no auto-accept path.
questions.sourceSection: Refine-cap exhaustion gates on accept, refine, or edit

questions.question: What now happens first when ensureAlignment finds a non-empty set of misaligned tests?
choices: The user is immediately asked to accept, rewrite, or drop each test
One automatic RealignInvocation runs, rewriting only misaligned sections in place
The misaligned tests are silently dropped from TESTS.md
The plan is returned as ready since verdicts are present
questions.rationale: A non-empty misaligned set first triggers one automatic RealignInvocation that rewrites only misaligned sections, and only tests still misaligned afterwards block on the accept/rewrite/drop gate.
questions.sourceSection: Misaligned tests get an automatic realign pass, then a user gate

questions.question: Why does the assumption-correction path pass withDemo=false to annotateAndRepublish?
choices: Demo generation is broken during the assumptions round
The status server forbids demo requests before refinement
Post-completion page annotations no longer need a demo at all
It runs before the refine loop rewrites the plan, and Run regenerates the demo at the end anyway, so a demo built there would be discarded unused
questions.rationale: A demo generated during the assumptions round would come from a plan the refine loop is about to rewrite, and Run regenerates the demo after planning succeeds, so skipping it saves one full AI invocation.
questions.sourceSection: Assumption corrections skip the wasted demo regeneration
